title: F42 · will_you_die · "Will You Die, Dadi?"
lines: A girl in her class lost her grandfather on Monday.
Adults usually say: Do not talk like that.
Adults usually say: "Do not talk like that."
See the moon? It is going. In a few days you will not see it at all.
"See the moon? It is going. In a few days you will not see it at all.
Then that is where I will be. And you will still see me, most nights.
"Then that is where I will be. And you will still see me, most nights."
Tell children the truth, gently. They can hold it. That is sadhana.
